name: Pricewatcha
description: Pricewatcha tracks product prices across online shops, keeps price history and sends price alerts and webhooks when prices change.

events.d: Search the price catalog, get a product by ID, or list your watched products.
Get a product's price history with lowest, highest and average price and trend.
Add a product page URL to Pricewatcha and get its current price, optionally watching it for updates.
Get the status and product result of a product tracking job.
Add a product to your watchlist so its price keeps updating.
Remove a product from your watchlist.
Create a price alert for a product with price thresholds or drop/rise notifications.
Update thresholds, notifications, name or status of a price alert.
List your price alerts, filter by product, or get one alert by ID.
Permanently delete a price alert by its ID.
